label: Code file
doc: One row per file at HEAD of an indexed branch — a pointer to current
state, not a per-commit history (the repo itself is that history; sha is
how a chunk cites the exact version it was read at).
F3's granularity is file, symbol and chunk-embedding. This type carries
the file level. Symbol-level chunking needs a chunk strategy that varies
by object type, which nothing in the registry expresses yet (`prose` says
WHICH fields are natural language, not HOW to split one into chunks) — so
today `body` is chunked by whatever generic recipe the indexer applies to
any prose field, and per-symbol splitting is a named next step, not a

sha.description: The blob's commit SHA — a free join key: the same value a PR, a check and a deploy already carry, so an edge to any of them costs no new correlation.

body.description: Full file text at this sha. The prose field — this is what gets chunked and embedded.
